key.decision_why: The author answered the feedback by tying the PR to existing issue #37647 and rebased, which a maintainer should see. The code is the same size, files and commit, so the first card is not misleading.
key.action_why: laurynmm replied asking for precise before/after screenshots and the completed self-review checklist before the PR can be reviewed, keeping "not ready".
changed: The author said the PR addresses the existing issue #37647, which answers the ask to discuss the change before opening a PR.
The author rebased on main (one force-push with no change in size, files or commit), and CI now passes.
The author recapped the three CSS changes: balanced left padding, a 34px row height for "None", and fit-content sizing with a max-width fallback.
still_missing: The PR has no before/after screenshots of the channel-folder and saved-snippets dropdowns, which visual changes need.
The PR description does not include the self-review checklist from the template.
The description does not formally link #37647 (for example with "Fixes #37647"), so the PR shows no linked issue.
key.reply_ask: Thank the author for linking #37647, and ask them to add precise before/after screenshots following the presenting-visual-changes guide and to complete the self-review checklist before review.

must_have.fact: Says the PR still has no before/after screenshots of the dropdown changes, which a visual CSS change needs before review.
Recommends keeping "not ready" and asking for more work rather than handing off to a reviewer.
Notes that the author now points to existing issue #37647 and that the only push since the feedback was a rebase with no code change.
Notes that the self-review checklist is missing from the PR description.
Flags that another open PR, #39267, targets the same channel-folder selector spacing issue.
